title: SOLIDWORKS workflows and connector status
description: Explore SOLIDWORKS workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

SoftwareUpcoming

Dassault Systèmes

SOLIDWORKS

SOLIDWORKS centres mechanical design on parametric parts, assemblies and production drawings.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Configure a pump-skid assembly

Use current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended SOLIDWORKS preview, configure a pump-skid assembly; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Check mates and clearances

Start from the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended SOLIDWORKS preview, check mates and clearances; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare a drawing and bill of materials

Begin with the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended SOLIDWORKS preview, prepare a drawing and bill of materials; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
